project.title: Study on the changes in species composition and functional genes after the spread of RP4 plasmid to denitrifying bacterial communities
project.description: Introduce RP4 plasmid into different denitrifying communities and investigate the long-term effects of RP4 plasmid invasion on microbial community composition and function through long-term experiments.
